title: Oslo peace process dinner: Clinton presses Arafat to take the deal; first impression of Putin

tellings.quote: And he says to Arafat, "Take the deal, Yasser. Take the deal. It's your last best chance for peace."

plain: At a dinner in the royal castle in Oslo, Norway, around 1998, President Bill Clinton urged the Palestinian leader Yasser Arafat, "Take the deal, Yasser. Take the deal. It's your last best chance for peace," with Israeli leader Ehud Barak and Vladimir Putin also part of the scene. Rolf Mowatt-Larssen, a former CIA officer, tells Jesse Michels he was there and also shares his first impression of Putin. He tells it as a first-hand view of a turning point in Middle East peace talks.
